Fetches custom models available to this: Fetches custom models available to this API key.
Natural: the model gets no instruction,: Natural: the model gets no instruction, so filler words such as “um” may appear in some places and be left out in others. Clean leaves them out, which suits dictation and notes. Verbatim transcribes them as spoken, which suits interviews. Rumble-2-Flash ignores this setting.
How strongly custom models and dictionar: How strongly custom models and dictionary terms steer recognition. Higher values recover these terms more often, but can also turn similar-sounding words into them. Default: {0}.
Keep dictionary in a custom model: Keep dictionary in a custom model
TypeWhisper keeps your dictionary terms: TypeWhisper keeps your dictionary terms in a custom model named “TypeWhisper Dictionary” in your Reson8 account and updates it when the dictionary changes. Reson8 then takes up to 50,000 terms instead of 250 per request. The model replaces a custom model configured on your API client; with a custom model selected, the terms go as phrases.
Patterns recover structured tokens such: Patterns recover structured tokens such as order codes or reference numbers. Each set appears as a model, so a workflow can use it where such tokens are spoken; Reson8 advises against applying patterns everywhere. Write the set's name on one line and one pattern per line below it, and separate sets with an empty line. [0-9] is a digit, [A-Z] a letter, {n} or {m,n} repeats what comes before, (…)? marks an optional part. Example: Order codes, then AMZ[0-9]{6}. Patterns replace dictionary terms and do not work with an API client that has a custom model configured.
Loads Reson8's models and the custom mod: Loads Reson8's models and the custom models available to this API key.
Sends half a second of silence with each: Sends half a second of silence with each saved pattern set, so Reson8 checks the patterns.
